additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
A customer was unable to stop his charging session. In SCB i saw that the charger sent a StopTransaction to our backend, i dont know why, the car was at 29%. And after the StopTransaction we can see that the car was charging until it reach 100%, the customer couldnt stop the charging session, for our backend the transaction was stopped so we couldnt stop the session on Greenflux, no more metervalues came from the charger and we will be not paid for this transaction. OCPP: Send command: Stop Transaction (c2cc574b-de45-466e-9217-5076c984b123) - {"meterStop":146743487,"timestamp":"2025-04- 23T13:35:09.054Z","transactionData":[{"timestamp":"2025-04-23T13:35:09.055Z","sampledValue": [{"value":"29","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"}, {"value":"0","location":"Outlet","unit":"Wh","context":"Transaction.End","measurand":"Energy.Active.Import.Interval"}]}],"transactionId":47243909}
Could you investigate please ?
